case_name: Anoop Jaiswal v Government Of India And Anr.
holding: The impugned order dated November 5, 1981 discharging the appellant from service is liable to be struck down. The appeal is accordingly allowed. The appellant should now be reinstated in service with the same rank and seniority he was entitled to before the impugned order was passed as if it had not been passed at all. He is also entitled to all consequential benefits including the appropriate year of allotment and the arrears of salary and allowances upto the date of his reinstatement.
